name: Kayo no Oshikko Gaman Jijou -Gekouchuu ni Oshikko Gaman Dekinakunatte-
original_name: カヨのおしっこ我慢事情 -下校中におしっこ我慢出来なくなって-
source:
A girl is about to pee before heading home with her brother but he rushes her
to go and she misses the chance. As she makes her way home she can't hold it in!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE257529.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个女孩在和她的兄弟回家之前正要撒尿，但他催促了她
要去，她错过了机会。回家的路上，她实在是按耐不住了！

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE257529.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
